name: Build 117
body:
- pelf: Added `--add-elf-section`: Lets you add custom elf sections to your AppBundles, which is useful for adding signing data, etc. It receives a file that ends in .elfS, the name of the file minus the extension determines the name of the elf section. The file's contents will be used as the elf section's contents

- pelf.go: Added `--add-updinfo`, Lets you an an elf section named .upd_info to the AppBundle, the contents of this which are the string passed to this flag. It should aid integration with software like https://github.com/AppImageCommunity/AppImageUpdate, etc

- pelf.go: Make `dwarfs` the default format

name: Build 96
body:
- Size reductions
- appstream-helper: handle extraction of embedded appstream data
- appstream-helper: comply with the format required by AM (it generates two repository indexes now)
  - Explanation: appstream-helper received a directory full of AppBundles and it generates a .json & .md file that can be used by `dbin` and the `.md` file by AM, these files basically define a repository. So creating a repo of AppBundles for `dbin` or `AM` is really easy and straightforward 
- The AM package manager will begin distributing AppBundles
- `dbin` already contains lots of them too :)

name: 3.0b0
body:
After many moons, I decided to make a manual release. This one marks the start of the 3.0 Betas, which will be manual releases showcasing new features.

After a few of this, `pelf 3.0` will land, with proper documentation, examples, and features.

Compared to the last nightly, now we:

- Smaller binary, we use the latest `dwarfs` source, to get a Musl binary that is greatly optimized
- Improved static_tools decompression time
- Recover from workDir corruption errors, whenever the .pid file in the workDir remains but the mounted dir is empty
- Added `--pbundle_cleanup` as a runtime flag that unmounts and cleans up the workDir, mountDir and poolDir of AppBundles
- Avoid overwriting existing decompressed static tools, to avoid crashing other running AppBundles
- Add more env vars, specifically: `ENABLE_FUSE_DEBUG`, `DWARFS_CACHESIZE`, `DWARFS_READAHEAD`, `DWARFS_BLOCKSIZE`, `DWARFS_WORKERS`
- `pelf` has shrunk by 4 megabytes!

Here are some benchmarks by @Samueru-sama

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/16b11d83-2dc6-41cf-9567-b12b92d9d8eb)

#### Consider this a provisional, unprofessional release. I need testers, basically!
